en: Good evening. Tonight we go after the story of an extraordinary personality.
zh: 晚上好。今晚我們將追尋一位非凡人物的故事。
ja: こんばんは。今夜は、並外れた人物の物語を追いかけます。
local: Good evening. Tonight we go after the story of an extraordinary personality.
ja_pron: Konbanwa. Kon'ya wa, namihazureta jinbutsu no monogatari o oikakemasu.
native: Good evening. Tonight we go after the story of an extraordinary personality.

en: He is Salvador Dali, the great surrealist painter who sees the world through surrealist eyes.
zh: 他是薩爾瓦多·達利，偉大的超現實主義畫家，用超現實的眼光看世界。
ja: 彼はサルバドール・ダリ、超現実主義の偉大な画家で、超現実的な目で世界を見ています。
local: He is Salvador Dali, the great surrealist painter who sees the world through surrealist eyes.
ja_pron: Kare wa Sarubadōru Dari, chōgenjitsu shugi no idaina gaka de, chōgenjitsuteki na me de sekai o miteimasu.
native: He is Salvador Dali, the great surrealist painter who sees the world through surrealist eyes.

en: If you're curious to hear Salvador Dali talk about decadence, death and immortality.
zh: 如果你想聽薩爾瓦多·達利談論頹廢、死亡與不朽。
ja: もしサルバドール・ダリが退廃、死、そして不死について語るのを聞きたいなら。
local: If you're curious to hear Salvador Dali talk about decadence, death and immortality.
ja_pron: Moshi Sarubadōru Dari ga taihai, shi, soshite fushi ni tsuite kataru no o kikitai nara.
native: If you're curious to hear Salvador Dali talk about decadence, death and immortality.

en: About his surrealist art, his politics and his existence before he was born,
zh: 關於他的超現實主義藝術、他的政治觀點以及他出生前的存在，
ja: 彼の超現実主義の芸術、政治、そして生まれる前の存在について、
local: About his surrealist art, his politics and his existence before he was born,
ja_pron: Kare no chōgenjitsu shugi no geijutsu, seiji, soshite umareru mae no sonzai ni tsuite,
native: About his surrealist art, his politics and his existence before he was born,

en: we'll go after those stories in just a moment.
zh: 我們馬上就會探討那些故事。
ja: すぐにそれらの物語を追いかけます。
local: we'll go after those stories in just a moment.
ja_pron: Sugu ni sorera no monogatari o oikakemasu.
native: we'll go after those stories in just a moment.

en: What's the point of this picture? Is there any point?
zh: 這幅畫的意義是什麼？有意義嗎？
ja: この絵の意味は何ですか？意味はありますか？
local: What's the point of this picture? Is there any point?
ja_pron: Kono e no imi wa nan desu ka? Imi wa arimasu ka?
native: What's the point of this picture? Is there any point?

en: Please, it's very important because myself work constantly in the moment of sleep.
zh: 請注意，這非常重要，因為我自己經常在睡眠時刻工作。
ja: お願いします、とても重要です。私は常に眠っている瞬間に働いています。
local: Please, it's very important because myself work constantly in the moment of sleep.
ja_pron: Onegaishimasu, totemo jūyō desu. Watashi wa tsuneni nemutte iru shunkan ni hataraiteimasu.
native: Please, it's very important because myself work constantly in the moment of sleep.

en: Every of my best ideas coming through my dreams.
zh: 我所有最好的點子都是透過夢境而來。
ja: 私の最高のアイデアはすべて夢を通じてやってきます。
local: Every of my best ideas coming through my dreams.
ja_pron: Watashi no saikō no aidea wa subete yume o tsūjite yattekimasu.
native: Every of my best ideas coming through my dreams.

en: Salvador Dali was obsessed with Sigmund Freud,
zh: 薩爾瓦多·達利著迷於西格蒙德·佛洛伊德，
ja: サルバドール・ダリはジークムント・フロイトに夢中でした。
local: Salvador Dali was obsessed with Sigmund Freud,
ja_pron: Sarubadōru Dari wa Jīkumunto Furoito ni muchū deshita.
native: Salvador Dali was obsessed with Sigmund Freud,

en: and you could say his beginnings were more than a little Freudian.
zh: 你可以說他的起點帶有濃厚的佛洛伊德色彩。
ja: 彼の始まりは少し以上にフロイト的だったと言えます。
local: and you could say his beginnings were more than a little Freudian.
ja_pron: Kare no hajimari wa sukoshi ijō ni Furoito-teki datta to iemasu.
native: and you could say his beginnings were more than a little Freudian.

en: Dali's mother gave birth to her first son in 1901,
zh: 達利的母親於1901年生下了她的第一個兒子，
ja: ダリの母親は1901年に最初の息子を産みました。
local: Dali's mother gave birth to her first son in 1901,
ja_pron: Dari no hahaoya wa 1901-nen ni saisho no musuko o umimashita.
native: Dali's mother gave birth to her first son in 1901,

en: a child that she named Salvador, who died at 22 months old.
zh: 她給孩子取名為薩爾瓦多，但孩子在22個月大時去世了。
ja: 彼女は子供にサルバドールと名付けましたが、その子は22ヶ月で亡くなりました。
local: a child that she named Salvador, who died at 22 months old.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kodomo ni Sarubadōru to nazukemashita ga, sono ko wa 22-kagetsu de nakunarimashita.
native: a child that she named Salvador, who died at 22 months old.

en: Just nine months later, the Salvador we know was born and was given his dead brother's name.
zh: 僅九個月後，我們所知的薩爾瓦多出生，並被賦予他已故兄弟的名字。
ja: わずか9ヶ月後、私たちが知っているサルバドールが生まれ、亡くなった兄の名前を与えられました。
local: Just nine months later, the Salvador we know was born and was given his dead brother's name.
ja_pron: Wazuka 9-kagetsu go, watashitachi ga shitte iru Sarubadōru ga umare, nakunatta ani no namae o ataeraremashita.
native: Just nine months later, the Salvador we know was born and was given his dead brother's name.

en: Dali was told by his parents that he was the literal reincarnation of his dead brother.
zh: 達利被父母告知，他是他已故兄弟的真實轉世。
ja: ダリは両親から、自分が亡くなった兄の文字通りの生まれ変わりだと言われました。
local: Dali was told by his parents that he was the literal reincarnation of his dead brother.
ja_pron: Dari wa ryōshin kara, jibun ga nakunatta ani no mojitoridōri no umarekawari da to iwaremashita.
native: Dali was told by his parents that he was the literal reincarnation of his dead brother.

en: A belief he carried into his adult life.
zh: 這種信念伴隨他進入成年生活。
ja: その信念は彼の大人の人生にも引き継がれました。
local: A belief he carried into his adult life.
ja_pron: Sono shinnen wa kare no otona no jinsei ni mo hikitsugaremashita.
native: A belief he carried into his adult life.

en: Sigmund Freud published interpretation of dreams in 1899,
zh: 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德於1899年出版了《夢的解析》，
ja: ジークムント・フロイトは1899年に『夢判断』を出版しました。
local: Sigmund Freud published interpretation of dreams in 1899,
ja_pron: Jīkumunto Furoito wa 1899-nen ni 'Yume Handan' o shuppan shimashita.
native: Sigmund Freud published interpretation of dreams in 1899,

en: in which he put forward the theory that dreams are the key to unlocking the secrets
zh: 他提出夢是解開潛意識秘密的關鍵的理論，
ja: その中で彼は、夢が無意識の秘密を解き明かす鍵であるという理論を提唱しました。
local: in which he put forward the theory that dreams are the key to unlocking the secrets
ja_pron: Sono naka de kare wa, yume ga muishiki no himitsu o tokiakasu kagi de aru to iu riron o teishō shimashita.
native: in which he put forward the theory that dreams are the key to unlocking the secrets

en: of the unconscious mind.
zh: 潛意識的秘密。
ja: 無意識の心の秘密です。
local: of the unconscious mind.
ja_pron: Muishiki no kokoro no himitsu desu.
native: of the unconscious mind.

en: To access his subconscious, Dali would make himself hallucinate.
zh: 為了進入潛意識，達利會讓自己產生幻覺。
ja: 潜在意識にアクセスするために、ダリは自分自身を幻覚状態にしました。
local: To access his subconscious, Dali would make himself hallucinate.
ja_pron: Senzai ishiki ni akusesu suru tame ni, Dari wa jibun jishin o genkaku jōtai ni shimashita.
native: To access his subconscious, Dali would make himself hallucinate.

en: Not with drugs, but rather by using what he called,
zh: 不是用藥物，而是用他所稱的方式，
ja: 薬物ではなく、彼が呼んだ方法を使っていました。
local: Not with drugs, but rather by using what he called,
ja_pron: Yakubutsu de wa naku, kare ga yonda hōhō o tsukatte imashita.
native: Not with drugs, but rather by using what he called,

en: he would take micronaps during the day.
zh: 他會在白天打短盹。
ja: 彼は昼間に短い仮眠を取っていました。
local: he would take micronaps during the day.
ja_pron: Kare wa hiruma ni mijikai karimin o totte imashita.
native: he would take micronaps during the day.

en: He would lie in a chair holding a heavy key in his right hand,
zh: 他會躺在椅子上，右手握著一把沉重的鑰匙，
ja: 彼は椅子に横たわり、右手に重い鍵を握っていました。
local: He would lie in a chair holding a heavy key in his right hand,
ja_pron: Kare wa isu ni yokotawari, migite ni omoi kagi o nigitte imashita.
native: He would lie in a chair holding a heavy key in his right hand,

en: underneath which he placed an upside down plate on the floor.
zh: 他在下面放了一個倒扣的盤子在地板上。
ja: その下に彼は逆さまの皿を床に置きました。
local: underneath which he placed an upside down plate on the floor.
ja_pron: Sono shita ni kare wa sakasama no sara o yuka ni okimashita.
native: underneath which he placed an upside down plate on the floor.

en: When he fell into a deep sleep, he dropped the key, and the Clang woke him up.
zh: 當他陷入深度睡眠時，他會掉落鑰匙，碰撞聲喚醒了他。
ja: 彼が深い眠りに落ちると、鍵を落とし、その音で目を覚ましました。
local: When he fell into a deep sleep, he dropped the key, and the Clang woke him up.
ja_pron: Kare ga fukai nemuri ni ochiru to, kagi o otoshi, sono oto de me o samashimashita.
native: When he fell into a deep sleep, he dropped the key, and the Clang woke him up.

en: In that nanosecond, he would enter a state scientist called Hip Nagogia,
zh: 在那一瞬間，他會進入科學家稱為「睡眠過渡期」的狀態，
ja: その一瞬で、彼は科学者がヒプナゴギアと呼ぶ状態に入りました。
local: In that nanosecond, he would enter a state scientist called Hip Nagogia,
ja_pron: Sono isshun de, kare wa kagakusha ga Hipunagogia to yobu jōtai ni hairimashita.
native: In that nanosecond, he would enter a state scientist called Hip Nagogia,

en: an in-between state where you are just beginning to dream, but are still conscious.
zh: 這是一種介於清醒與夢境之間的狀態，剛開始做夢但仍保持意識。
ja: 夢を見始めたばかりで、まだ意識がある中間の状態です。
local: an in-between state where you are just beginning to dream, but are still conscious.
ja_pron: Yume o mihajimeta bakari de, mada ishiki ga aru chūkan no jōtai desu.
native: an in-between state where you are just beginning to dream, but are still conscious.

en: He would use this method with the persistence of memory,
zh: 他用這種方法創作了《記憶的持續》，
ja: 彼はこの方法を『記憶の固執』で使いました。
local: He would use this method with the persistence of memory,
ja_pron: Kare wa kono hōhō o 'Kioku no koshitsu' de tsukaimashita.
native: He would use this method with the persistence of memory,

en: a painting that although stylistically rooted in realism transcends the world of reason.
zh: 這幅畫雖然風格上根植於現實主義，但超越了理性的世界。
ja: この絵は様式的にはリアリズムに根ざしていますが、理性の世界を超えています。
local: a painting that although stylistically rooted in realism transcends the world of reason.
ja_pron: Kono e wa yōshiki-teki ni wa riarizumu ni nezashiteimasu ga, risei no sekai o koeteimasu.
native: a painting that although stylistically rooted in realism transcends the world of reason.

en: The strange, confusing, and often disturbing world we visit in our dreams
zh: 我們在夢中造訪的奇異、混亂且常令人不安的世界，
ja: 私たちが夢の中で訪れる奇妙で混乱し、しばしば不安を感じる世界は、
local: The strange, confusing, and often disturbing world we visit in our dreams
ja_pron: Watashitachi ga yume no naka de otozureru kimyō de konran shi, shibashiba fuan o kanjiru sekai wa,
native: The strange, confusing, and often disturbing world we visit in our dreams

en: would make Dali a household name.
zh: 使達利成為家喻戶曉的名字。
ja: ダリを誰もが知る名前にしました。
local: would make Dali a household name.
ja_pron: Dari o dare mo ga shiru namae ni shimashita.
native: would make Dali a household name.

en: And he would remain so for more than half a century,
zh: 而且他將持續保持這樣的名聲超過半個世紀，
ja: そして彼は半世紀以上もそのままでした。
local: And he would remain so for more than half a century,
ja_pron: Soshite kare wa han seiki ijō mo sono mama deshita.
native: And he would remain so for more than half a century,

en: one of the best known and most bitterly contested figures in the international art world.
zh: 成為國際藝術界最知名且爭議激烈的人物之一。
ja: 国際芸術界で最もよく知られ、最も激しく論争された人物の一人です。
local: one of the best known and most bitterly contested figures in the international art world.
ja_pron: Kokusai geijutsukai de mottomo yoku shirare, mottomo hageshiku ronsō sareta jinbutsu no hitori desu.
native: one of the best known and most bitterly contested figures in the international art world.

en: In 1938, after years of trying, Dali would finally meet Freud,
zh: 1938年，經過多年的努力，達利終於見到了佛洛伊德，
ja: 1938年、何年もの努力の後、ダリはついにフロイトに会いました。
local: In 1938, after years of trying, Dali would finally meet Freud,
ja_pron: 1938-nen, nan-nen mo no doryoku no ato, Dari wa tsuini Furoito ni aimashita.
native: In 1938, after years of trying, Dali would finally meet Freud,

en: which he likened to meeting God.
zh: 他將這次會面比喻為見到了上帝。
ja: 彼はそれを神に会うことに例えました。
local: which he likened to meeting God.
ja_pron: Kare wa sore o kami ni au koto ni tatoemashita.
native: which he likened to meeting God.

en: Freud was 81, Dali 34.
zh: 佛洛伊德81歲，達利34歲。
ja: フロイトは81歳、ダリは34歳でした。
local: Freud was 81, Dali 34.
ja_pron: Furoito wa 81-sai, Dari wa 34-sai deshita.
native: Freud was 81, Dali 34.

en: By all accounts, they would totally be wielded by each other,
zh: 據說他們彼此完全被對方影響，
ja: すべての話によると、彼らは完全にお互いに影響を受けました。
local: By all accounts, they would totally be wielded by each other,
ja_pron: Subete no hanashi ni yoru to, karera wa kanzen ni otagai ni eikyō o ukemashita.
native: By all accounts, they would totally be wielded by each other,

en: and Dali would later disavow Freud.
zh: 而達利後來否認了佛洛伊德。
ja: そしてダリは後にフロイトを否認しました。
local: and Dali would later disavow Freud.
ja_pron: Soshite Dari wa nochi ni Furoito o hinin shimashita.
native: and Dali would later disavow Freud.

en: Great art comes from conflict, and Dadaism and Surrealism were two art movements
zh: 偉大的藝術源於衝突，達達主義和超現實主義是兩個藝術運動，
ja: 偉大な芸術は葛藤から生まれ、ダダイズムとシュルレアリスムは二つの芸術運動でした。
local: Great art comes from conflict, and Dadaism and Surrealism were two art movements
ja_pron: Idaina geijutsu wa kattō kara umare, Dadaizumu to Shururearisumu wa futatsu no geijutsu undō deshita.
native: Great art comes from conflict, and Dadaism and Surrealism were two art movements

en: that developed as a direct result of the horrors of the First World War.
zh: 這兩個運動是第一次世界大戰恐怖的直接結果。
ja: それらは第一次世界大戦の恐怖の直接的な結果として発展しました。
local: that developed as a direct result of the horrors of the First World War.
ja_pron: Sorera wa Daiichiji Sekai Taisen no kyōfu no chokusetsuteki na kekka to shite hatten shimashita.
native: that developed as a direct result of the horrors of the First World War.

en: A war so brutal and incomprehensible that artists look for unconventional ways
zh: 這場戰爭如此殘酷且難以理解，以致藝術家尋找非常規的方式，
ja: あまりにも残酷で理解し難い戦争のため、芸術家たちは型破りな方法を探しました。
local: A war so brutal and incomprehensible that artists look for unconventional ways
ja_pron: Amari ni mo zankoku de rikai shigatai sensō no tame, geijutsuka-tachi wa katayaburi na hōhō o sagashimashita.
native: A war so brutal and incomprehensible that artists look for unconventional ways

en: to make sense of the world, and their rage drove their artistic creativity.
zh: 以理解這個世界，他們的憤怒推動了他們的藝術創造力。
ja: 世界を理解するために、彼らの怒りが芸術的創造力を駆り立てました。
local: to make sense of the world, and their rage drove their artistic creativity.
ja_pron: Sekai o rikai suru tame ni, karera no ikari ga geijutsuteki sōzōryoku o karitatemashita.
native: to make sense of the world, and their rage drove their artistic creativity.

en: Dadaism, which preceded Surrealism, was more of an anti-art movement.
zh: 達達主義先於超現實主義，更像是一種反藝術運動。
ja: シュルレアリスムに先立つダダイズムは、より反芸術的な運動でした。
local: Dadaism, which preceded Surrealism, was more of an anti-art movement.
ja_pron: Shururearisumu ni sakidatsu Dadaizumu wa, yori han geijutsuteki na undō deshita.
native: Dadaism, which preceded Surrealism, was more of an anti-art movement.

en: Surrealism was about finding a bridge between the subconscious and reality.
zh: 超現實主義是尋找潛意識與現實之間的橋樑。
ja: シュルレアリスムは潜在意識と現実の間の橋を見つけることでした。
local: Surrealism was about finding a bridge between the subconscious and reality.
ja_pron: Shururearisumu wa senzai ishiki to genjitsu no aida no hashi o mitsukeru koto deshita.
native: Surrealism was about finding a bridge between the subconscious and reality.

en: The founder of the Surrealist Art Movement, Andre Breton,
zh: 超現實主義藝術運動的創始人安德烈·布勒東，
ja: シュルレアリスト芸術運動の創設者、アンドレ・ブルトンは、
local: The founder of the Surrealist Art Movement, Andre Breton,
ja_pron: Shururearisuto geijutsu undō no sōsetsusha, Andore Buruton wa,
native: The founder of the Surrealist Art Movement, Andre Breton,

en: worked at a military hospital in Paris and had been an eyewitness to the horrors of the war.
zh: 曾在巴黎的一家軍事醫院工作，親眼目睹了戰爭的恐怖。
ja: パリの軍病院で働き、戦争の恐怖を目撃しました。
local: worked at a military hospital in Paris and had been an eyewitness to the horrors of the war.
ja_pron: Pari no gunbyōin de hataraki, sensō no kyōfu o mokugeki shimashita.
native: worked at a military hospital in Paris and had been an eyewitness to the horrors of the war.

en: He saw firsthand how mental trauma patients rejected the rational world
zh: 他親眼看到精神創傷患者如何拒絕理性世界，
ja: 彼は精神的外傷患者が理性的な世界を拒絶する様子を直接見ました。
local: He saw firsthand how mental trauma patients rejected the rational world
ja_pron: Kare wa seishinteki gaishō kanja ga riseiteki na sekai o kyozetsu suru yōsu o chokusetsu mimashita.
native: He saw firsthand how mental trauma patients rejected the rational world

en: and inspired by Sigmund Freud, he would seek to liberate the subconscious through art.
zh: 受西格蒙德·佛洛伊德啟發，他試圖通過藝術解放潛意識。
ja: ジークムント・フロイトに触発され、彼は芸術を通じて潜在意識を解放しようとしました。
local: and inspired by Sigmund Freud, he would seek to liberate the subconscious through art.
ja_pron: Jīkumunto Furoito ni shokuhatsu sare, kare wa geijutsu o tsūjite senzai ishiki o kaihō shiyō to shimashita.
native: and inspired by Sigmund Freud, he would seek to liberate the subconscious through art.

en: There is no dominant painting style in Surrealism,
zh: 超現實主義中沒有主導的繪畫風格，
ja: シュルレアリスムには支配的な絵画スタイルはありません。
local: There is no dominant painting style in Surrealism,
ja_pron: Shururearisumu ni wa shihaiteki na kaiga sutairu wa arimasen.
native: There is no dominant painting style in Surrealism,

en: but the public face of it would become Salvador Dali.
zh: 但其公開形象將成為薩爾瓦多·達利。
ja: しかし、その公の顔はサルバドール・ダリとなりました。
local: but the public face of it would become Salvador Dali.
ja_pron: Shikashi, sono ōyake no kao wa Sarubadōru Dari to narimashita.
native: but the public face of it would become Salvador Dali.

en: The moustacheoed self-promoter was instantly recognizable,
zh: 這位留著鬍鬚的自我推銷者立刻就能被認出，
ja: 口ひげを生やした自己宣伝者はすぐに認識されました。
local: The moustacheoed self-promoter was instantly recognizable,
ja_pron: Kuchihige o hayashita jiko senden-sha wa sugu ni ninshiki saremashita.
native: The moustacheoed self-promoter was instantly recognizable,

en: as were his landscapes of melting watches.
zh: 他的融化時鐘風景畫也同樣著名。
ja: 溶ける時計の風景画も同様に有名でした。
local: as were his landscapes of melting watches.
ja_pron: Tokeru tokei no fūkeiga mo dōyō ni yūmei deshita.
native: as were his landscapes of melting watches.

en: As a painter, Dali had experimented with lots of styles amongst others,
zh: 作為畫家，達利嘗試過許多風格，其中包括，
ja: 画家として、ダリはいくつものスタイルを試みました。その中には、
local: As a painter, Dali had experimented with lots of styles amongst others,
ja_pron: Gaka to shite, Dari wa ikutsumo no sutairu o kokoromimashita. Sono naka ni wa,
native: As a painter, Dali had experimented with lots of styles amongst others,

en: foveism, naturalism, and cubism.
zh: 野獸派、自然主義和立體主義。
ja: フォービズム、ナチュラリズム、キュビズムが含まれます。
local: foveism, naturalism, and cubism.
ja_pron: Fōbizumu, nachurarizumu, kyubizumu ga fukumaremasu.
native: foveism, naturalism, and cubism.

en: Then in 1926, for the first time he visited Paris,
zh: 然後在1926年，他首次造訪巴黎，
ja: そして1926年、彼は初めてパリを訪れました。
local: Then in 1926, for the first time he visited Paris,
ja_pron: Soshite 1926-nen, kare wa hajimete Pari o otozuremashita.
native: Then in 1926, for the first time he visited Paris,

en: which was the cultural centre of the world, and began interacting with artists,
zh: 那裡是世界的文化中心，他開始與藝術家互動，
ja: そこは世界の文化の中心地で、彼は芸術家たちと交流を始めました。
local: which was the cultural centre of the world, and began interacting with artists,
ja_pron: Soko wa sekai no bunka no chūshin-chi de, kare wa geijutsuka-tachi to kōryū o hajimemashita.
native: which was the cultural centre of the world, and began interacting with artists,

en: such as Picasso, Magrit, and Miro.
zh: 如畢卡索、馬格利特和米羅。
ja: ピカソ、マグリット、ミロなどです。
local: such as Picasso, Magrit, and Miro.
ja_pron: Pikaso, Maguritto, Miro nado desu.
native: such as Picasso, Magrit, and Miro.

en: Which led to Dali's first Surrealistic works.
zh: 這促成了達利的第一批超現實主義作品。
ja: それがダリの最初のシュルレアリスティックな作品につながりました。
local: Which led to Dali's first Surrealistic works.
ja_pron: Sore ga Dari no saisho no Shururearisutikku na sakuhin ni tsunagarimashita.
native: Which led to Dali's first Surrealistic works.

en: However, this recently discovered work was produced while he was still a teenager,
zh: 然而，這件最近發現的作品是在他還是青少年時期創作的，
ja: しかし、この最近発見された作品は彼がまだ十代の頃に制作されました。
local: However, this recently discovered work was produced while he was still a teenager,
ja_pron: Shikashi, kono saikin hakken sareta sakuhin wa kare ga mada jūdai no koro ni seisaku saremashita.
native: However, this recently discovered work was produced while he was still a teenager,

en: showing us not only that he was an early Surrealist,
zh: 這不僅顯示他是早期的超現實主義者，
ja: それは彼が初期のシュルレアリストであったことを示しています。
local: showing us not only that he was an early Surrealist,
ja_pron: Sore wa kare ga shoki no Shururearisuto de atta koto o shimeshiteimasu.
native: showing us not only that he was an early Surrealist,

en: but that he was also already referring to himself in the third person.
zh: 而且他已經開始用第三人稱來指稱自己。
ja: さらに彼はすでに三人称で自分自身を指していました。
local: but that he was also already referring to himself in the third person.
ja_pron: Sarani kare wa sudeni sanninshō de jibun jishin o sashiteimashita.
native: but that he was also already referring to himself in the third person.

en: Today the art world is unshockable,
zh: 如今藝術界已經不易被震驚，
ja: 今日の芸術界は驚かされることが少なくなりましたが、
local: Today the art world is unshockable,
ja_pron: Kyō no geijutsukai wa odorokasareru koto ga sukunaku narimashita ga,
native: Today the art world is unshockable,

en: but Dali's uncensored imagination,
zh: 但達利那不受審查的想像力，
ja: しかし、ダリの検閲されていない想像力は、
local: but Dali's uncensored imagination,
ja_pron: Shikashi, Dari no ken'etsu sarete inai sōzōryoku wa,
native: but Dali's uncensored imagination,

en: his images of sex, blood and excrement,
zh: 他關於性、血液與排泄物的畫面，
ja: 彼の性、血、排泄物のイメージは、
local: his images of sex, blood and excrement,
ja_pron: Kare no sei, chi, haisetsubutsu no imēji wa,
native: his images of sex, blood and excrement,

en: even under the guise of the subconscious, was subversive and scandalous.
zh: 即使披著潛意識的外衣，也具有顛覆性和醜聞性。
ja: 潜在意識の仮面の下でも、それは破壊的でスキャンダラスでした。
local: even under the guise of the subconscious, was subversive and scandalous.
ja_pron: Senzai ishiki no kamen no shita demo, sore wa hakai-teki de sukyandarasudesu.
native: even under the guise of the subconscious, was subversive and scandalous.

en: Dali would be expelled from the Surrealist group in 1934.
zh: 達利於1934年被逐出超現實主義團體。
ja: ダリは1934年にシュルレアリストグループから追放されました。
local: Dali would be expelled from the Surrealist group in 1934.
ja_pron: Dari wa 1934-nen ni Shururearisuto gurūpu kara tsuihō saremashita.
native: Dali would be expelled from the Surrealist group in 1934.

en: For amongst other things, he's fascination with Hitler,
zh: 部分原因是他對希特勒的迷戀，
ja: その理由の一つは、彼のヒトラーへの魅了でした。
local: For amongst other things, he's fascination with Hitler,
ja_pron: Sono riyū no hitotsu wa, kare no Hitora e no miryō deshita.
native: For amongst other things, he's fascination with Hitler,

en: who he once said turned him on.
zh: 他曾說過希特勒讓他著迷。
ja: 彼はかつてヒトラーに惹かれたと言いました。
local: who he once said turned him on.
ja_pron: Kare wa katsute Hitora ni hikareta to iimashita.
native: who he once said turned him on.

en: But by this time, he was already a well-known painter,
zh: 但此時，他已經是知名畫家，
ja: しかしこの時点で、彼はすでに有名な画家でした。
local: But by this time, he was already a well-known painter,
ja_pron: Shikashi kono jiten de, kare wa sudeni yūmei na gaka deshita.
native: But by this time, he was already a well-known painter,

en: and on his way to becoming a celebrity.
zh: 並且正走在成為名人的路上。
ja: そしてセレブになる道を歩んでいました。
local: and on his way to becoming a celebrity.
ja_pron: Soshite serebu ni naru michi o arundeimashita.
native: and on his way to becoming a celebrity.

en: The first thing to note is that despite its huge cultural impact,
zh: 首先要注意的是，儘管它有巨大的文化影響，
ja: 最初に注目すべきは、その巨大な文化的影響にもかかわらず、
local: The first thing to note is that despite its huge cultural impact,
ja_pron: Saisho ni chūmoku subeki wa, sono kyodai na bunkateki eikyō ni mo kakawarazu,
native: The first thing to note is that despite its huge cultural impact,

en: it is quite small, about the size of a sheet of paper.
zh: 它相當小，大約只有一張紙的大小。
ja: それはかなり小さく、紙一枚ほどの大きさです。
local: it is quite small, about the size of a sheet of paper.
ja_pron: Sore wa kanari chiisaku, kami ichimai hodo no ōkisa desu.
native: it is quite small, about the size of a sheet of paper.

en: Dali plays with a perception of scale and presents a huge desert landscape
zh: 達利玩弄尺度感，呈現出一幅巨大的沙漠景觀，
ja: ダリはスケールの感覚を操り、巨大な砂漠の風景を描いています。
local: Dali plays with a perception of scale and presents a huge desert landscape
ja_pron: Dari wa sukēru no kankaku o ayatsuri, kyodai na sabaku no fūkei o egaiteimasu.
native: Dali plays with a perception of scale and presents a huge desert landscape

en: with vast depths of field reduced to a shrunken world,
zh: 將廣闊的景深縮小成一個縮小的世界，
ja: 広大な被写界深度を縮小された世界にしています。
local: with vast depths of field reduced to a shrunken world,
ja_pron: Kōdai na hishakai shindo o shukushō sareta sekai ni shiteimasu.
native: with vast depths of field reduced to a shrunken world,

en: as if we are looking down the wrong end of a telescope.
zh: 彷彿我們在望遠鏡的錯誤端觀看。
ja: まるで望遠鏡の逆の端を見ているかのようです。
local: as if we are looking down the wrong end of a telescope.
ja_pron: Marude bōenkyō no gyaku no hashi o mite iru ka no yō desu.
native: as if we are looking down the wrong end of a telescope.

en: In the same way Dali uses scale to subvert our ideas of reality,
zh: 達利同樣利用尺度顛覆我們對現實的觀念，
ja: ダリは同じようにスケールを使って私たちの現実の概念を覆します。
local: In the same way Dali uses scale to subvert our ideas of reality,
ja_pron: Dari wa onaji yō ni sukēru o tsukatte watashitachi no genjitsu no gainen o kutsugaeshimasu.
native: In the same way Dali uses scale to subvert our ideas of reality,

en: he does so with extreme photo realism.
zh: 他以極端的照片寫實主義來做到這一點。
ja: 彼は極端なフォトリアリズムでそれを行います。
local: he does so with extreme photo realism.
ja_pron: Kare wa kyokutan na fotoriarizumu de sore o okonaimasu.
native: he does so with extreme photo realism.

en: He painted the unreal world with such realism
zh: 他以如此寫實的手法描繪不真實的世界，
ja: 彼は非現実的な世界を非常にリアルに描きました。
local: He painted the unreal world with such realism
ja_pron: Kare wa higennjitsuteki na sekai o hijō ni riaru ni egakimashita.
native: He painted the unreal world with such realism

en: that no matter how irrational the vision,
zh: 無論這個視覺多麼不理性，
ja: どんなに非合理的なビジョンでも、
local: that no matter how irrational the vision,
ja_pron: Donna ni higoriteki na bijon demo,
native: that no matter how irrational the vision,

en: it is still believable.
zh: 它仍然是可信的。
ja: それでも信じられるのです。
local: it is still believable.
ja_pron: Soredemo shinjirareru no desu.
native: it is still believable.

en: This is what makes him unique.
zh: 這就是使他獨特的原因。
ja: これが彼を唯一無二にしているのです。
local: This is what makes him unique.
ja_pron: Kore ga kare o yuiitsu muni shite iru no desu.
native: This is what makes him unique.

en: In 1931, Dali was 27 broke,
zh: 1931年，達利27歲時破產，
ja: 1931年、ダリは27歳で破産していました。
local: In 1931, Dali was 27 broke,
ja_pron: 1931ねん、ダリは27さいではさんしていました。
native: In 1931, Dali was 27 broke,

en: and living in a recently purchased fishing cottage
zh: 住在剛買下的漁村小屋裡，
ja: そして最近購入した漁村の小屋に住んでいました。
local: and living in a recently purchased fishing cottage
ja_pron: そしてさいきんこうにゅうしたぎょそんのこやにすんでいました。
native: and living in a recently purchased fishing cottage

en: in the town of Port Ligat,
zh: 位於波爾特利加特鎮，
ja: ポルト・リガットの町にありました。
local: in the town of Port Ligat,
ja_pron: ポルト・リガットのまちにありました。
native: in the town of Port Ligat,

en: with his future wife, Gala.
zh: 和他的未來妻子加拉一起。
ja: 未来の妻ガラと一緒に住んでいました。
local: with his future wife, Gala.
ja_pron: みらいのつまガラといっしょにすんでいました。
native: with his future wife, Gala.

en: Gala would be a divisive figure for the Surrealists,
zh: 加拉對超現實主義者來說是個具爭議的人物，
ja: ガラはシュルレアリストの間で賛否両論の人物でした。
local: Gala would be a divisive figure for the Surrealists,
ja_pron: ガラはシュルレアリストのあいだでさんぴりょうろんのじんぶつでした。
native: Gala would be a divisive figure for the Surrealists,

en: and as Dali's fame and fortune grew,
zh: 隨著達利的名聲和財富增長，
ja: そしてダリの名声と富が増すにつれて、
local: and as Dali's fame and fortune grew,
ja_pron: そしてダリのめいせいととみがますにつれて、
native: and as Dali's fame and fortune grew,

en: she would be constantly at his side.
zh: 她總是陪伴在他身邊。
ja: 彼女は常に彼のそばにいました。
local: she would be constantly at his side.
ja_pron: かのじょはつねにかれのそばにいました。
native: she would be constantly at his side.

en: The life are never ending round of carefully choreographed appearances.
zh: 生活是一連串精心安排的公開露面，永無止境。
ja: 生活は綿密に演出された終わりのない登場の連続でした。
local: The life are never ending round of carefully choreographed appearances.
ja_pron: せいかつはめんみつにえんしゅつされたおわりのないとうじょうのれんぞくでした。
native: The life are never ending round of carefully choreographed appearances.

en: While the rocky landscape in the background
zh: 背景中岩石嶙峋的景觀，
ja: 背景の岩だらけの風景は、
local: While the rocky landscape in the background
ja_pron: はいけいのいわだらけのふうけいは、
native: While the rocky landscape in the background

en: may look like an ambiguous dreamscape,
zh: 看起來像是模糊的夢境，
ja: あいまいな夢の風景のように見えますが、
local: may look like an ambiguous dreamscape,
ja_pron: あいまいなゆめのふうけいのようにみえますが、
native: may look like an ambiguous dreamscape,

en: it is actually inspired by the surroundings at Port Ligat,
zh: 實際上是受到波爾特利加特周圍環境的啟發，
ja: 実際にはポルト・リガットの周囲の風景に触発されています。
local: it is actually inspired by the surroundings at Port Ligat,
ja_pron: じっさいにはポルト・リガットのしゅういのふうけいにしょくはつされています。
native: it is actually inspired by the surroundings at Port Ligat,

en: specifically the coastal cliffs of Captain Clears,
zh: 特別是克里爾斯船長的海岸懸崖，
ja: 特にキャプテン・クリアーズの海岸の崖です。
local: specifically the coastal cliffs of Captain Clears,
ja_pron: とくにキャプテン・クリアーズのかいがんのがけです。
native: specifically the coastal cliffs of Captain Clears,

en: a peninsula close to the artist's home.
zh: 這是靠近藝術家家的半島。
ja: それは芸術家の家の近くにある半島です。
local: a peninsula close to the artist's home.
ja_pron: それはげいじゅつかのいえのちかくにあるはんとうです。
native: a peninsula close to the artist's home.

en: The triangular shadow that appears to crawl across the canvas
zh: 那個似乎在畫布上爬行的三角形陰影，
ja: キャンバスを這うように見える三角形の影は、
local: The triangular shadow that appears to crawl across the canvas
ja_pron: キャンバスをはうようにみえるさんかくけいのかげは、
native: The triangular shadow that appears to crawl across the canvas

en: is believed to be cast by Mount Pani,
zh: 被認為是由帕尼山投射的，
ja: パニ山によって投げかけられたものと考えられています。
local: is believed to be cast by Mount Pani,
ja_pron: パニさんによってなげかけられたものとかんがえられています。
native: is believed to be cast by Mount Pani,

en: a mountain near the artist's home.
zh: 這座山靠近藝術家的家。
ja: その山は芸術家の家の近くにあります。
local: a mountain near the artist's home.
ja_pron: そのやまはげいじゅつかのいえのちかくにあります。
native: a mountain near the artist's home.

en: This early painting in the Impressionistic style
zh: 這幅早期的印象派風格畫作，
ja: この初期の印象派スタイルの絵は、
local: This early painting in the Impressionistic style
ja_pron: このしょきのいんしょうはスタイルのえは、
native: This early painting in the Impressionistic style

en: is the view from that mountain summit.
zh: 是從那座山頂看到的景色。
ja: その山頂からの眺めです。
local: is the view from that mountain summit.
ja_pron: そのさんちょうからのながめです。
native: is the view from that mountain summit.

en: To me, it's almost certain that his use of space
zh: 對我來說，他對空間的運用幾乎可以確定，
ja: 私には、彼の空間の使い方はほぼ間違いなく、
local: To me, it's almost certain that his use of space
ja_pron: わたしには、かれのくうかんのつかいかたはほぼまちがいなく、
native: To me, it's almost certain that his use of space

en: was inspired by the earlier images of Georgio de Kirico,
zh: 是受到喬治奧·德·基里柯早期作品的啟發，
ja: ジョルジョ・デ・キリコの初期の作品に触発されたものです。
local: was inspired by the earlier images of Georgio de Kirico,
ja_pron: ジョルジョ・デ・キリコのしょきのさくひんにしょくはつされたものです。
native: was inspired by the earlier images of Georgio de Kirico,

en: who was like Dali, a follower of Freud.
zh: 他和達利一樣，是佛洛伊德的追隨者。
ja: 彼はダリのようにフロイトの信奉者でした。
local: who was like Dali, a follower of Freud.
ja_pron: かれはダリのようにフロイトのしんぽうしゃでした。
native: who was like Dali, a follower of Freud.

en: From the landscape itself, only a few features emerge.
zh: 從風景本身來看，只有少數特徵浮現。
ja: 風景自体からは、いくつかの特徴だけが浮かび上がります。
local: From the landscape itself, only a few features emerge.
ja_pron: ふうけいじたいからは、いくつかのとくちょうだけがうかびあがります。
native: From the landscape itself, only a few features emerge.

en: One is the dead olive tree,
zh: 其中之一是枯死的橄欖樹，
ja: その一つは枯れたオリーブの木です。
local: One is the dead olive tree,
ja_pron: そのひとつはかれたオリーブのきです。
native: One is the dead olive tree,

en: growing out of a large square platform.
zh: 從一個大型方形平台中長出來。
ja: 大きな四角い台座から生えています。
local: growing out of a large square platform.
ja_pron: おおきなしかくいだいざからはえています。
native: growing out of a large square platform.

en: The olive tree, a symbol of peace, is dead.
zh: 橄欖樹，和平的象徵，已經枯死。
ja: オリーブの木は平和の象徴ですが、枯れています。
local: The olive tree, a symbol of peace, is dead.
ja_pron: オリーブのきはへいわのしょうちょうですが、かれています。
native: The olive tree, a symbol of peace, is dead.

en: This reflects the uneasy political climate at the time,
zh: 這反映了當時不安定的政治氣候，
ja: これは当時の不安定な政治情勢を反映しています。
local: This reflects the uneasy political climate at the time,
ja_pron: これはとうじのふあんていなせいじじょうせいをはんえいしています。
native: This reflects the uneasy political climate at the time,

en: between the First World War and the unrest
zh: 介於第一次世界大戰與動盪之間，
ja: 第一次世界大戦と不穏な情勢の間で、
local: between the First World War and the unrest
ja_pron: だいいちじせかいたいせんとふおんなじょうせいのあいだで、
native: between the First World War and the unrest

en: leading to the impending Spanish Civil War.
zh: 導致即將來臨的西班牙內戰。
ja: 差し迫ったスペイン内戦へとつながる不安定さです。
local: leading to the impending Spanish Civil War.
ja_pron: さしせまったスペインないせんへとつながるふあんていさです。
native: leading to the impending Spanish Civil War.

en: Francesco Goya is considered by many scholars
zh: 許多學者認為弗朗西斯科·戈雅，
ja: フランシスコ・ゴヤは多くの学者によって、
local: Francesco Goya is considered by many scholars
ja_pron: フランシスコ・ゴヤはおおくのがくしゃによって、
native: Francesco Goya is considered by many scholars

en: to be the basis for modern art,
zh: 被視為現代藝術的基礎，
ja: 現代美術の基礎と考えられています。
local: to be the basis for modern art,
ja_pron: げんだいびじゅつのきそとかんがえられています。
native: to be the basis for modern art,

en: bridging classicism and romanticism.
zh: 連結古典主義與浪漫主義。
ja: 古典主義とロマン主義をつなぐ存在です。
local: bridging classicism and romanticism.
ja_pron: こてんしゅぎとロマンしゅぎをつなぐそんざいです。
native: bridging classicism and romanticism.

en: He deeply influenced Salvador Dali in his early years.
zh: 他深刻影響了達利的早期創作。
ja: 彼はダリの若い頃に深い影響を与えました。
local: He deeply influenced Salvador Dali in his early years.
ja_pron: かれはダリのわかいころにふかいえいきょうをあたえました。
native: He deeply influenced Salvador Dali in his early years.

en: We can compare the dead olive tree here
